property.description: 5G DoS attack in the control plane: the total number of packets carrying an NGAP InitialUEMessage, from all gNBs, in a 1 ms window is greater than the limit fixed by the MMT_SEC_5G_DOS_NGAP_INITIALUEMESSAGE_MS_LIMIT environment variable (one alert per window; the rule is disabled when the variable is unset or 0)
